text: Figure 13.35: Secure Communication over TLS It is a common use case that only one end of a TLS-based connection is actually modeled in an AUTOSAR model. It is therefore important that the modeling does not rely on or imply knowledge about both ends of such a TLS-based connection. An AUTOSAR model that only describes one end of the communication is positively required to work, independently of the availability of a formal modeling of the other end.
